{
  "project": "agentic-knowledge-mapper",
  "what_building": "A risk assessment and knowledge mapping service for multi-agent LLM systems. It generates structured risk registers and exposure tiers based on product and model descriptors.",
  "pipeline": [
    "ingest_brief",
    "map_product_risk",
    "map_model_risk",
    "synthesize_knowledge_graph",
    "emit_risk_register"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "product_description",
    "model_description",
    "risk_brief",
    "specific_security_questions"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "risk_register",
    "exposure_tiers",
    "knowledge_graph",
    "residual_risk_assessment"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.85,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "Product: multi-agent debate systems (safety, robustness, and operational risks)",
    "Brief: Enumerate documented and hypothesized risks: sycophancy and conformity pressure among agents",
    "schema hints: ['brief', 'exposure tier', 'knowledge graph', 'misuse potential', 'model risk', 'residual risk', 'schema']",
    "query_types: {'context-heavy': 302, 'research': 217, 'chat': 214, 'chart/price': 210, 'trade': 142, 'supply': 82, 'mining': 37, 'qa': 2, '(none)': 1}"
  ]
}
